name: B & G Gourmet Bakery and Deli

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Two cheesecakes were observed in the sliding cooler without date marking. Education occurred about date marking requirements- items taken from freezing to cooling must be marked with the date that they are moved into thawing. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) marked the items with the date the items were moved into refrigeration. Ensure items moved into thawing are marked with the original date they were moved into thawing. Those food items must be used or discarded within 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. Refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The probe thermometer in the facility’s hot holding was observed to be broken. CORRECTED- the PIC brought out a working probe thermometer to be used and the broken thermometer was voluntarily discarded.
findings.citation_text: 4-203.11 Temperature Measuring Devices, Food. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES that are scaled only in Celsius or dually scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±1°C in the intended range of use. (B) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2°F in the intended range of use. [Pf]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Lettuce was observed stored below raw hamburger meat on the door of the fridge. CORRECTED- PIC rearranged storage. Store meats below ready-to-eat foods to prevent potential cross contamination.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Facility’s probe thermometer (stored in the hot holding unit) was observed reading less than 100F when found in the hot holding unit (above 135F). CORRECTED- Inspector demonstrated how to calibrate the thermometer using ice water.
4-203.11: (A) FOOD TEMP. MEASURING DEVICE shall be accurate to  +/- 1 Celsius (B) accurate to +/- 2 Fahrenheit.  [Pf]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment: Eggs stored above ready-to-eat foods in the fridge (on the top shelf). CORRECTED- Storage rearranged to prevent potential cross contamination. Store raw foods below RTE. Ref. 3-302.11 [P]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: Tuna salad observed without any date-marking. CORRECTED- PIC made salad on Friday and labeled it accordingly. Ensure all foods that will remain in the facility for more than 24 hours are labeled with the date prepared/opened. Ref. 3-501.17 [Pf]
